column3: One-line npm ignore file containing only "*.map", excluding source maps from the published package.
One-line ambient type reference to vite/client, giving the app the Vite client types.
Five-line Cordis overlay setting session-controller.nativeOpen false so the changed-files card header stays a label and rows preview in the Sidebar.
15-line PWA manifest: name DeepSeek Harness, short_name DSH, fullscreen display, one any-size SVG icon favicon.svg.
Eight-line overlay pointing agent-default-model at acme-gateway/acme-think so the fixture-less scaffold has a route an adapter can serve.
Eight-line overlay pointing agent-default-model at origin-gateway/origin-large, with the reason that a fixture-less scaffold registers no adapter.
Eleven-line overlay pinning nativeOpen true on session-controller and settings-controller and enabling ui-sidebar-browser so CI and desktop expose the same link-opening branch.
Browser stand-in for node:module whose createRequire throws "node:module is not available in the browser" so an unreachable path fails loud; exports LoadHookContext as never.
15-line HTML shell with the PWA manifest link, colour-scheme-aware favicon links, div#root and the /src/main.ts module script.
30-line overlay disabling the four stable tool-subagent* tools and inserting the experimental agent-team, tool-agent-team and ui-agent-team bundles with their limits.
14-line worker-preview bootstrap: chooseWorkerHostSource then connectWorkerHost, after which the served startup chain runs verbatim.
Vite pre-plugin rewriting the KaTeX stylesheet to keep only WOFF2 sources and throwing "KaTeX font face requires a WOFF2 source" when a face has none.
Helper exposing AUTO_REVIEW_FIXTURE (the experimental auto-review bundle patch and package.json as overlay/anchors) plus an opt-in screenshot capture keyed on DSH_AUTO_REVIEW_SCREENSHOT_DIR.

44-line RemoteMock spec: create plus two prompts, then the session list shows blank false and running true, session/follow yields exactly one turn/start and user/message per prompt, and assertNoUnmatched closes the run.

Browser entry: builds AppWebEntry; in the desktop shell awaits dshDesktopBoot.ready(), installs index injections, publishes __DSH_TRANSPORT__ and resolves or rejects the shared __DSH_BOOT_READY__ gate, routing failures to desktop.failed.
Pins that six modified Enter chords leave the composer draft and slash menu byte-identical and that Shift+Enter inserts a soft break without emitting a user/message.

jsdom spec of src/main.ts with dsh-client-web mocked: failures forwarded to desktop.failed, a failing ready() rejects __DSH_BOOT_READY__, browser-only boot keeps failure presentation in the Web kernel, and the missing-root/missing-readiness messages are exact.

Declares @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend 0.2.1-rc.2, exports only ./dist/*, ships dist minus sourcemaps and the preview build, and lists the workspace client packages and experimental bundles the Web bundle depends on.
Two table cases over recorded diff sessions: the collapsed edit row carries the +N -N totals and the expanded card must not repeat them, with the shared context line appearing exactly once.
Pins that the composer placeholder hides on any whitespace (typed, pasted, whitespace-only submit) and returns when the content is deleted.
Writes an agent/inbox/spliced event straight to persistence with no live agent and requires the pending row to appear on open, survive a reload, and be editable and removable.

Proves historical generated-plugin cards still render after their tool APIs are removed: cordis_define is absent from the schema list, the recorded definition source shows in the Host tab, and the stop row reports ok.
3-line SVG holding one roughly 3.6KB single-path whale mark filled #fff; identical path data to favicon.svg with the fill inverted for dark mode.
3-line SVG holding one roughly 3.6KB single-path whale mark filled #000; the light-mode favicon linked by index.html.
Replays a historical Messages-provider conversation and requires the recorded provider id to survive in the request header while the picker shows the display name DeepSeek.
Uses the real cancellation fixture to require the keyed Bash row to expose the recorded command and the full "Error: tool call aborted" even though no terminal card material was produced.

Two Vite plugins: browserDependencyAnalysis refuses any build that can write output, and productWebBundleIsolation instruments Vite css transform to capture chunk, asset, CSS and worker inputs and verifies no experimental package reaches the shipped bundle.
Table test over writer-held true/false: the selected blank session is reused, a held writer causes a new blank rather than another blank, and the attached-session count is asserted exactly.

Requires the context-details panel to stay 12px inside the viewport at three widths with and without the Chat statistics contribution, and to show a percentage-of-context label plus a tok and Cache hit row only when statistics are on.
Pins the 16px Chat flow spacing through the display:contents slot anchor and re-measures it at three font sizes; the present case also asserts the presented-files row and turn footer offsets.
Cold replay of an Auto-review user rejection plus a reviewer failure, requiring the identity "Rejected by Auto review" rather than the generic user rejection and the reviewer error string verbatim.

Closes the remote.mux WebSocket with code 1012 three times and requires a new ready frame and session/follow baseline each time, the root element still connected, the draft intact and zero navigations.
Injects a __DSH_LOCALE__ bridge and requires the OS languages not to be saved, an explicit choice to persist as preference en in the profile patch, and localStorage dsh.locale to stay null.

Built-graph jsdom scenario: a command not declaring input.attachments refuses with one alert banner keeping the draft and rail, a declaring command consumes the images and clears the composer, and a bare slash-plan with an image submits as an image-only plan.
Three-file read pins the read metadata lang and the preview language for .pyi, .ps1 and .csv, requires actual highlighting in both surfaces, and requires CSV to default to the Spreadsheet viewer.
A blank session recorded under an undeclared preset must come back under standard with the fallback recorded as an agent-preset/selected event, while a still-declared preset restores unchanged.
A temporary 1017 release badge decorates both DeepSeek routes without changing catalog identity, is absent from the External provider group, fits a 390px menu and differs between themes.
Independent-writer XLSX previews must open comments and Tables without hiding cell data, print an exact unsupported-features notice, omit hidden sheets, and copy a cell through the system clipboard.

Intercepts __ModuleLoader__ in the page to capture the real Client registry and requires it to equal the Host roster with every entry ACTIVE and zero experimental package references; a second half deliberately mounts one and shows it appears.
Requires settings and expanded plugin dialogs to clear the Windows caption with a 60px/24px margin model and a 40px mask, and re-checks the same geometry for darwin (68px) and browser (24px).

The preset page is read-only for shipped compositions (no copy/edit/open-dir/delete), the viewer shows the real shipped declaration in the Loader dialect without __jsExpr, and the creator entry is verified via the Host session/list projection.

Prebuilt DevTools assets served under inspector/devtools/ with 401 unauthenticated, a 302 directory redirect preserving the query, 404 for unknown assets and path traversal, HEAD empty, POST 405, no importmap and no unsafe-inline.

Cold replay of an Auto-review denial: the fixture shape is checked first (AutoReviewDeniedError, AUTO_REVIEW_DENIED, a reason carrying embedded CRLF, no top-level callId), the row shows only the Auto identity and a normalized reason, shows OUT but not IN, and the Trajectory ledger carries the code.

One DeepSeek card, a base-URL placeholder naming DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL, the API key written to .credentials.yaml rather than the profile patch, systemPromptUpdate in-history, and an editable composer after the default model is removed.

The Show-coding-view switch persists to the profile patch and survives a reload, and the built-in PTC and Minimal presets appear only while it is on, with the new-task default surviving the switch being toggled back off.

First-use startup prepares one durable Workspace and one blank Session that survives a reload, uses a fixed language-neutral directory name, surfaces a conflict as a localized alert with the folder picker, and keeps an explicitly deleted default absent.

Clicking the composer unused space (four distinct points) must restore the previous caret and selection with its direction, and typing replaces that restored selection and resumes at the restored caret.

Requires read-card gutters to keep line numbers clear of the source in both wrap modes and long diff rows to fill the horizontally scrolled column in both themes, using a fixture built through the real Session API.

Generates a deterministic multi-turn chat fixture through the Session API with unique semantic markers, a protected system head, paired bash calls every eighth turn and code fences every eleventh, so pagination exercises real event shapes.

Drives the Desktop update states through a stubbed presentation-only carrier: a download is non-actionable, a failure keeps the same palette with a different label, and the evidence JSON records that no Electron or installer ran.
Three named fold policies over a recorded turn replayed as a continuation, with the persisted turn/end events as ground truth and the recorded fixture required to be unchanged on disk.
Opt-in stress that pushes 100000 reasoning chunks through the real carriers while measuring main-thread tick and scheduled-interaction delay against a 250ms budget.

Requires a capped approval panel whose cap is derived from the live composer, proves the cap is engaged by asserting the region scrolls, answers by button and by keyboard with the same approval/decided event, and refuses a passive interactions-none WebSocket subscriber.

A real background bash job discovered from the tool output must appear in the header, be owned by the exact live Agent, be killed by a two-press armed control, and sit above an expanded right sidebar proven by corner hit-testing.

Built-bundle boot smoke: the official and local branding are chosen by the verified client build record, the resident fixture actionable state is projected as Waiting for answer and Approval, the ContextMeter composition panel is reachable, and every plugin style tag is present.

The Agent Teams panel is read-only (no edit controls, no projection calls) yet reflects Host-side task mutations live, the local overlay must equal the shipped patch, and the 120ms dismissal grace plus a resize-driven Show more are pinned.

Real-composition OAuth sign-in against a loopback Platform double: the callback tab has no opener, auth_init carries login_source web and the right redirect_uri, and avatar retry recovers only on the third entry.

The effort picker must offer exactly the declared levels (Default, Off, High, Max) with the declared wire spelling, the chosen effort persists in the Agent default section, and the scenario runs in Chromium and WebKit.

Twelve composer-driven replay turns with exact per-turn event-shape assertions, DOM rows bound to event identity rather than position, and the request header appearing once so the prefix stays stable.

Boots the real built client bundles through AppWebEntry ModuleLoader against a RemoteMock transport, deriving the graph from the same bundle patches dsh web uses, with bootstrap and application batches and an exhaustive jsdom stub and teardown list.
The RemoteMock scenario for built-client tests: cloned captured Host responses per world, fabricated image attachments and commands, and typed accessors that throw instead of returning undefined.

The composer is one editable surface with one scroll offset and a 14-LINE cap (not pixels); the golden records relations rather than absolute coordinates, and every case starts with an overflow vacuity guard.

Both permission pickers expose the experimental Auto entry behind a locale-aware in-page confirmation with a disabled-until-acknowledged button naming the concrete risks, and the dangerous mode is not restored when the plugin is reinstalled.

Chat reserves a stable scrollbar gutter and Trajectory does not; the input card must not move between tabs, proven by a control that removes the seat compensation in-page and shows the card then moves by half the band.

Page-local client plugin lifecycle: a live plugin session-menu row is ordered among shipped rows, two pages stay in sync, a failed download is retried per page, a bootstrap-module swap is refused with a reload message, and the Host fiber uid never changes.

Long-history contract that stays valid under virtualization: rows are bound to event identity, the DOM order equals the semantic order, the turn rail virtualizes with an outline preview, and a branch inherits exactly the prefix up to its boundary.

The paid native Flash translation route over real Anthropic Messages SSE: only the token is stubbed, the request body is asserted exactly (no tools, disabled thinking), the audit record carries the full modelRequest, and the main conversation is untouched.

Free provider translation: wire-level request assertions for Google and Bing, no credentials on the wire, nothing translated until the plugin is enabled, translated text never in model history, records paired request/result with a recipe identity, and a cancelled request leaving no output.

Per-Session Sidebar state: panes, tabs, expanded directories and the manual fullscreen mode are retained across switches, the fullscreen panel keeps the grid columns, and a capacity-close protects the user widened sidebar preference.

One turn producing every clickable link and artifact form: unique-basename mentions only, inert contrasts, the link language asserted by computed style, and link opening routed by the three-mode setting.

A session composition is fixed at start (the header labels it and offers no control), the applied preset is read from the Host projections, a failing preset is omitted but stays debuggable, and switching re-reads the slash catalog.

The onboarding step persists and resumes, a failing balance refresh does not block the flow, a granted bonus stays unacknowledged until the workspace, and an API key completes onboarding without showing it.

The composer model switch writes the deployment default, a session created afterwards follows it while a logged session keeps its own route, removing a provider does not retain its profile, and both pickers share order and sticky material.

Drafts are structured persisted objects with references; a nine-row transition matrix fixes the prompt and clear semantics, only the latest of two overlapping creations gets the draft, and a late catalog re-matches without touching text, selection or undo.

A notice is acknowledged only after display, one settings entry causes one read, a transient ack failure retries after a backoff with an identical body, showing writes no storage, and stacked cards animate on promotion.

A git-workspace turn ends with the changed-files card; ignored files counts come from the write call rather than git, a preparing row leaks no arguments, the card geometry is pinned exactly, and edge gestures are proven with CDP scroll gestures.

Opt-in benchmark over 1000 sessions and a 500-turn history that reports CDP metrics without timing assertions, forces a GC before reading retained DOM, node, listener and heap state, and refuses a probe that saw no trusted click.

Virtualizer-neutral long-transcript geometry contracts: the seed event shape is checked, the model stream is gated for deterministic interleavings, per-frame fold traces are compared against an analytic expected scroll position with no reversal, and a running Session stays stationary across a return.

Document previews: the HTML iframe is sandboxed and live-revocable, hostile HTML is sanitized to zero hrefs, iframes and requests, PDFs render in a dsh-pdf worker at device resolution under a 16MB bitmap ceiling, Office conversion is cached, and the font warning keeps the document position.
